name: Sonic KQXS
author: qycaca

sections.description:
Sonic KQXS displays public Vietnam lottery results in WordPress with shortcode-based views, live refreshes, local caching, statistics, and prediction summary modules.

The plugin supports Northern (XSMB), Central (XSMT), and Southern (XSMN) regions, province history, weekday history, and Vietlott results. Historical result views use AJAX loading and cache-aware rendering so initial pages stay lightweight.

Features:

  • Vietnam lottery results for XSMB, XSMT, and XSMN.
  • Province-based and weekday-based result views.
  • Vietlott Mega 6/45 and Power 6/55 support.
  • Live result refresh with optimized caching.
  • AJAX loading for historical results.
  • Statistics views for frequency, missing numbers, cycles, head-tail analysis, and special-prize results from 00 to 99.
  • Native WordPress prediction posts with publish-by-default and optional draft modes.
  • Data-led prediction copy with 10, 20, and 30-draw comparisons, draw-hit counts, current gaps, and special-tail profiles.
  • Automatic Media Library featured images, result tables, frequency grids, and head-tail charts when GD is available.
  • Native categories, tags, titles, excerpts, and content that remain editable by WordPress and compatible SEO plugins.
  • Schedule-aware prediction and browser-based trial draw tools for each daily station.
  • Responsive front-end layout for mobile and desktop.
  • Vietnamese and English localization.
  • WordPress locale-aware language selection.

Shortcodes:

  • [kqxs_home] – Main lottery dashboard.
  • [kqxs_mien region="mb"] – Regional results. Supported values: mb, mt, mn.
  • [kqxs_tinh province="ha-noi"] – Province result history.
  • [kqxs_ngay date="2026-06-06"] – Results by date.
  • [kqxs_thu day="thu-2"] – Results by weekday.
  • [kqxs_vietlott game="mega645"] – Vietlott results.
  • [kqxs_thong_ke] – Statistics, including the special-prize 00-99 tab.
  • [kqxs_du_doan] – Published prediction article hub.
  • [kqxs_quay_thu] – Trial draw hub for XSMB, XSMT, XSMN, and Vietlott with weekday or province selection.

External Services

Sonic KQXS uses the 383.im data service and connects to configured HTTPS JSON endpoints under api.383.im to display public Vietnam lottery results.

Service website: https://383.im/
Terms of Service: https://383.im/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://383.im/privacy-policy/

Requests are made when:

  • A lottery shortcode is rendered.
  • Live data is refreshed.
  • Historical results are loaded through AJAX.
  • A scheduled refresh task runs.
  • An administrator prebuilds cache from the plugin admin screen.

The request may include the server IP address, the plugin User-Agent, and the requested endpoint path. The plugin does not send visitor personal data to the service and does not add the site domain to its request User-Agent.

Example endpoint patterns:

  • https://api.383.im/lottery/live.json
  • https://api.383.im/lottery/region/*.json
  • https://api.383.im/lottery/province/*.json
  • https://api.383.im/lottery/weekday/*.json
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sonic-kqxs folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate “Sonic KQXS” from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Review the API settings under the Sonic KQXS admin page.
  4. Add a Sonic KQXS shortcode to any page, post, or widget area that supports shortcodes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support live results?

Yes. Live results are refreshed through the plugin data layer with caching to avoid unnecessary repeated requests.

Does it store historical data?

Yes. Historical result responses can be cached locally for performance and refreshed by scheduled tasks or admin tools.

Does it support Vietlott?

Yes. Mega 6/45 and Power 6/55 result displays are supported.

Does it include prediction features?

Yes. It can create native WordPress prediction posts from recent result data. New posts publish by default, remain editable, and can include Media Library visuals when GD is available.

Does it include trial draws?

Yes. The trial draw hub supports Northern, Central, Southern, province, and Vietlott simulations. Trial results run in the browser and are not saved as historical lottery results.

Will it replace my SEO plugin metadata?

No. Prediction posts use native WordPress titles, excerpts, taxonomies, featured images, and permalinks. Sonic KQXS does not force hard-coded SEO titles or descriptions.

Is any visitor personal data sent to the external service?

No. The plugin requests public lottery JSON endpoints. It does not send visitor personal data to the external API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Isolated the administration workspace from promotional theme and plugin notices without hiding critical WordPress errors.
  • Added the standard WordPress notice anchor so global notices no longer move inside the Sonic KQXS hero.
  • Restored Dashicons after the scoped administration typography reset.
  • Changed newly generated prediction posts to publish by default while preserving saved administrator choices and the optional draft workflow.

1.0.6

  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1, including the public shortcodes, settings workspace, server-generated prediction images, and native prediction posts.
  • Rebuilt the responsive lottery workspace with unified content/sidebar navigation, schedule-aware province links, smooth AJAX transitions, and standalone prediction navigation that returns to the detected [kqxs_home] host page.
  • Expanded regional, province, weekday, and Vietlott result views with two initial draws, live waiting states, full-screen number boards, and 30-draw special-prize history.
  • Added complete 00-99, regional, loto, gap, head-tail, falling-loto, and detailed Vietlott statistics with independent 15, 30, 45, 60, and 90-draw controls.
  • Added schedule-aware Prediction and Trial draw hubs, sequential prize drawing, automatic Northern draws, manual-start Central and Southern selections, complete multi-station boards, province-tabbed 30-draw special-prize analysis, and open-by-default Vietlott statistics.
  • Upgraded native WordPress prediction posts with draft-by-default publishing, editable data-led analysis, readable stored HTML, categories, tags, excerpts, and automatic Media Library visuals.
  • Redesigned the administration workspace with accessible controls, system checks, cache tools, unsaved-change protection, and settings migration that preserves administrator choices.
  • Removed duplicate saved-settings notices, unified public and administration typography, and paginated large 00-99 draw matrices while retaining full-sample frequency totals.
  • Refactored PHP request context, options, schedules, AJAX, caching, rendering, and uninstall cleanup while retaining PHP 7.4 compatibility.
  • Isolated plugin constants with the SONIC_KQXS_* prefix, hardened external requests with the WordPress safe HTTP API, skipped prediction visuals safely when GD is unavailable, and removed duplicate lifecycle registration to avoid theme or plugin conflicts.
  • Completed scoped CSS, hardened JavaScript, readable generated source, Vietnamese and English localization, and WordPress Plugin Check validation.

1.0.5

  • Finalized WordPress.org review cleanup for bundled PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and translation files.
  • Documented the external data service with service website, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy links.
  • Improved PHP 7.4 compatibility and uninstall cleanup.
  • Added a translation template file for maintainable localization updates.

1.0.4

  • Documented the external data service, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy.
  • Reworked bundled JavaScript into readable source files.
  • Cleaned and grouped front-end and admin CSS.
  • Improved AJAX request sanitization and nonce handling.
  • Removed broad cache flushing and tightened cache cleanup scope.
  • Updated Vietnamese and English translation files.

1.0.3

  • Fixed guideline compliance issues.
  • Improved sanitization, escaping, and admin permission checks.

1.0.2

  • Added statistical analysis module for lottery result insights.
  • Added prediction display system with scheduled summaries.
  • Updated external API endpoint to api.383.im.
  • Improved performance and caching structure.

1.0.1

  • Added Vietnam lottery result displays for MB, MT, and MN.
  • Added Vietlott Mega 6/45 and Power 6/55 support.
  • Added province, weekday, and regional shortcodes.
  • Added statistics dashboard views.
  • Added AJAX-based loading for historical results.
  • Added English and Vietnamese localization.
  • Improved mobile UI and front-end performance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
